proof_scope: In progress. R1766 proves cancellation against tests with bounded cell oscillation, the explicit classical Fourier estimate |Ff(xi)| <= (2*pi*|xi|/K)*||f||_1, and the unit-support inequality ||f||_1^2 <= integral ||f||^2. For normalized real L2 representatives supported in [0,1] with zero closed-grid-cell means, the classical low-frequency squared integral on [-R,R] is at most 8*pi^2*R^3/K^2. A threshold uniform over these functions makes this at most 1/256. Separately, every real Hilbert-space linear contraction satisfies |<Tf,f>-<Tg,g>| <= ||f-g||*(||f||+||g||). If ||f||=1, ||f-g||<=1/16 and <Tf,f>>=1/2, then <Tg,g>>=95/256. This applies to the actual Mobius average. The identification of the classical integral with Mathlib's L2 Fourier transform and the actual high-frequency decomposition are still unproved here.
